mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up this journey through the world of salt, sugar, and fat, I hope you're feeling both a little wiser and a lot more empowered. The forces shaping what we eat are everywhere—they're built into science, business, culture, and our own routines. But here's the thing: real change is absolutely possible. It all starts with awareness, grows with those small, everyday choices, and truly comes alive when we're in it together with others. So what does this all mean for you? Well, food companies are experts at designing products that keep us coming back for more. Salt, sugar, and fat—they’re all used to override those natural signals that should tell us, “Hey, I’ve had enough.” And so often, profit wins out over our well-being. Processed foods aren’t just a local thing—they’ve gone global, reshaping diets and health everywhere. But here’s the truly hopeful part: even small, steady changes in how we eat can add up to a real difference. If you've ever stood in the grocery store feeling overwhelmed by choices, or found yourself reaching for that familiar snack out of pure habit—you're not alone. The system is set up to tempt us, but you have more power than you think. Every meal is a new chance. You can try something different, return to something simple, or just make a choice that feels a little more nourishing. The path forward isn’t about being perfect—it’s about progress, about finding what fits for you and your family, and supporting others who are on this path too. So, as you move ahead, remember: the story of food is still being written. With every decision, you help create a future where health, joy, and connection are truly at the center of the table. Celebrate the small wins, and know that every step you take with awareness and intention is a step toward a brighter, more vibrant life. You’ve got this.
